crewGirlPlot.title: Crew Girl Plot
crewGirlPlot.intro: Crew Girl centers on Teagan Tao, who moves into a new environment because of a family scandal. As she joins a boys' rowing team, she must navigate athletic competition, changing friendships, and romantic tension while trying to establish her own identity.

crewGirlRowingGuide.title: Crew Girl Rowing Guide
crewGirlRowingGuide.intro: Crew Girl uses the structure of rowing to show teamwork, pressure, and leadership. This quick guide explains the basic roles and terms viewers need to understand the boat, the coxswain, and the erg scores discussed by the team.

terms.meaning: A rowing team and, by extension, the boat and athletes competing together.
terms.onTheWater: Every rower must match the crew's rhythm, sequence, and power to move the boat efficiently.
terms.inTheStory: The crew structure makes teamwork and trust essential to the characters' competitive progress.

terms.meaning: A rower's place in the boat, which determines their responsibilities within the stroke sequence.
terms.onTheWater: Athletes in different seats contribute to balance, rhythm, power, and boat control.
terms.inTheStory: Positioning helps explain why athletes can have different roles even when they are racing in the same boat.

terms.meaning: The crew member who directs the boat and communicates with the rowers during training and racing.
terms.onTheWater: The coxswain calls commands, helps maintain rhythm, manages race strategy, and keeps the crew focused.
terms.inTheStory: The role highlights leadership and communication, two recurring sources of pressure within a rowing team.

terms.meaning: An indoor rowing machine used for training and performance testing.
terms.onTheWater: Rowers use the erg to build fitness and compare measurable performance outside the boat.
terms.inTheStory: Erg sessions create a direct way for characters to compete, prove themselves, and respond to pressure.

terms.meaning: A personal record on an ergometer, usually measured over a set distance or time.
terms.onTheWater: The score provides an individual benchmark for speed, endurance, and training progress.
terms.inTheStory: A PR can affect confidence, selection expectations, and how teammates evaluate an athlete's potential.

terms.meaning: The repeated sequence of movements used by rowers, performed together as a coordinated cycle.
terms.onTheWater: Consistent timing allows the crew to apply power without disrupting the boat's balance and speed.
terms.inTheStory: Matching rhythm turns individual effort into team performance and mirrors the characters' need to work together.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about Crew Girl, Netflix's teen rowing drama

questions.question: What is Crew Girl about?
questions.answer: Crew Girl is a Netflix teen rowing drama about Teagan Tao, an elite young sculler who joins an all-boys prep-school crew team after a family scandal, where competition, friendship, and romance collide.

questions.question: How many episodes of Crew Girl are there?
questions.answer: Crew Girl season 1 has 8 episodes, all released on Netflix on September 10, 2026.

questions.question: Where can I watch Crew Girl?
questions.answer: Crew Girl streams on Netflix. The series is rated TV-14 and is available in every region where Netflix operates.

questions.question: Who plays Teagan Tao in Crew Girl?
questions.answer: Miku Martineau plays Teagan Tao, with Sam Braun as Josh Regis and Kyle Clark as Cam Dillinger rounding out the central cast of Crew Girl.

questions.question: What does 'crew' mean in Crew Girl?
questions.answer: In rowing, a crew is the team of athletes propelling one boat. The sport gives Crew Girl its backbone: stroke rhythm, erg scores, and the coxswain's calls all matter to the story.

questions.question: Is Crew Girl getting more episodes?
questions.answer: Crew Girl season 1 is complete on Netflix. Any news about future episodes will come through Netflix official channels and be covered in the site's Release updates.
